about.body: The B48 is BMW's turbocharged 2.0-litre inline-four petrol engine, in production since 2014 and closely related to the B58 six-cylinder. It's one of BMW's most widely-deployed engines, fitted across every mainstream model line from the 1 Series up to the 5 Series, plus the X1, X2, X3, X4, X5 and Z4 roadster.

byModel.body: The B48 is the standard four-cylinder petrol option across the BMW range. In the 1 Series, it powers the 118i, 120i and 125i (F20/F21, 2015–2019). The 2 Series carries it in the 218i, 220i and 225i (F22/F23, 2014–present). The 3 Series uses it across the 318i, 320i and 330i (F30/F31, 2015–2019), while the 4 Series has it in the 420i and 430i (F32/F33/F36, 2015–2020). The 5 Series uses the B48 in the 520i and 530i (G30/G31, 2016–2023). Across the SUV range, it appears in the X1 (sDrive18i, xDrive20i, xDrive25i, F48), X2 (sDrive18i, xDrive20i, xDrive25i, F39), X3 (xDrive20i, xDrive30i, G01), X4 (xDrive20i, xDrive30i, G02), and early X5 xDrive40i (G05). The Z4 also uses it in the sDrive20i and sDrive30i (G29).

compatibility.body: Because the B48 spans 11 different models and multiple generations — with different chassis-specific ancillaries across each — compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model, generation, and drivetrain spec, which we do by registration. A B48 from a 1 Series isn't a drop-in match for a B48 from an X5, even though it's the same base engine code — ancillaries, mounting, and drivetrain configuration all differ. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm your exact vehicle.
